title: Observer — subscribe and notify (Python)
description: Observers subscribe to a subject; notify() pushes updates to all of them. The backbone of event-driven design and MVC views.
how_it_works: The subject keeps a listener list; notify iterates it with the new value.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Observers that throw can break the loop — isolate listener errors. Reproduce it once on purpose in a scratch file: seeing the failure teaches the fix faster than reading about it.
